summary: Retractable Technologies filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, announcing a board-declared dividend on its Series II and Series III Class B Convertible Preferred Stock, totaling $39,050.00 and $18,561.25, respectively. Dividends accrued at $1.00 per share per annum for the quarter from July 1 to September 30, 2026, payable October 22, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on October 12, 2026. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99. No premium, stake, or advisor is disclosed. What to watch: the preferred dividend obligation and its cash cost, though not a special-situation arb event.
